collection.description: A visitor from another village hugs a villager like an old friend, and the villager has no idea who they are.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (visitor), a visitor from another village, walks up to (subject), beaming, and hugs (subject.him/her). "(subject)! It's been so long! How are you? How's your knee?" (subject) has absolutely no idea who this person is. (subject.His/Her) knee is fine. (subject.He/She) thinks.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: "Oh, it's fine, thank you! And you?" (visitor) talks happily for some time about people and places (subject) doesn't recognize. (subject) nods in all the right places. Just as (visitor) leaves, (visitor.he/she) says, "Give my love to the stew pot!" and (subject) suddenly remembers everything. (visitor) is already gone.

a__fx.name: Answer A
a__fx.text: "I'm so sorry," says (subject). "I'm terrible with faces. Remind me?" (visitor) laughs. "The harvest feast, years ago! You helped me carry a pot of stew, and you fell over, and we both ended up covered in it." (subject) remembers instantly. They spend the afternoon catching up. (subject.His/Her) knee, it turns out, was the one (subject.he/she) landed on.
